text: Night sky, a tiny floating island with a vegetable bed, tree, and a blue bunny-like creature. It says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, 10 coins. Tapping the crop bed.
Harvest gave +3 coins and 3 XP. Now it's sunny Day 3. Bottom shows Sow / Water / Harvest buttons, 1 sec each. Hint says tap the farm to sow.
Oops, the bunny (named Momo) walked onto the bed and I selected Momo instead. Panel says 'Free time' and 'Assign'. I'll tap the bed's left edge instead.
Sown! Seeds visible. Sunset already - a day is only 30 sec. Now 'Tap again to water'.
Watered. Harvest '2s left'. Now the hint says 'Tap a Momo' - highlighting the bunny. OK, tapping it.
Crops are already ripe again (tomatoes). Hint: 'Tap the pencil to pick the tiles this Momo looks after'. So Momo is a worker I can assign to tiles. Tapping the pencil.
Tile picking mode: 0/4 tiles. I'll tap the farm bed tile first - that's what Momo should tend.
Momo now 'Working at Farm', farm skill 0. Tile labelled 1. Only one building exists so I'll confirm with the checkmark.
Momo harvests on its own now: +$3, rate went to $9/min, 19 coins. An envelope popped up and Mailbox has a red dot. Opening the mailbox.
Mailbox: letter from Momo 'What if we widened the field?' Cute. Opening it.
Charming letter - Momo proposes 'Field expansion' research. Pressing 'Let's research it'.
It's now 'On the research list'. Let me open the Research screen to see what that means.
Research tree with tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion costs 3 flasks + $20, 20s. I have no flasks; button says 'Build a research lab'. Trying it.
A build menu appeared: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. So the lab is locked until Lv2 - I'm Lv1 49/90. I have $40, so I'll build a second farm.
Paid $10, a new farm is under construction on the right tile - wait, the tree disappeared? I didn't get to choose where it goes; I think I tapped that spot. Another letter waiting. Waiting for build.
New farm is built and Momo hopped over to work it. The first farm is ripe and waiting - I'll harvest it myself by tapping. Almost Lv2 (76/90).
Level 2 with confetti! Research lab and Lumberyard unlocked. $51. I want a research lab. Tapping the empty grass on the left to see if it opens the build menu.
Tapping empty grass opens the build menu. Research lab $40, I have $57. Building it on this left tile.
Lab is under construction (4s). A new hint: 'The island can grow here - $40' with a box off the island edge - so I can expand land. I only have $23. Meanwhile, reading my new letter.
The lab is a cute blue-roof house with a flask sign. Bottom has an 'Experiment 3 sec' button. New letter: 'Maybe we could water less often'. Opening it.
Momo suggests Watering efficiency. Accepting that too, then closing and running an Experiment at the lab.
A flask counter '1' appeared under the day - I got a research note from the lab, I think. Hint: 'Tap the glowing sea to grow the island' ($40). I have $41. Let's grow the island!
'$40 Tap again to buy' - a confirm step, good. Little flags on the farms now. Confirming.
The island grew a new tile (with a bush), +15 EXP. Flasks now 2. A tip box explains empty tiles build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab and how to demolish. Dismissing with Got it.
Island is now longer. I need 3 flasks for Field expansion; I have 2. Tapping the lab to run an experiment myself.
3 flasks now and Research has a red dot. $28 - enough for Field expansion ($20). Opening Research.
3/3 flasks, 'Start research' is available. Starting Field expansion (Crops +1).
Researching, 19s. Both farms are ripe now. I'm curious about 'Next: City 0/4' in the top-left. Closing research and tapping it.
The 'Next: City' label shifted down when the flask counter appeared, so I missed it. Trying again at its new spot.

Status panel: island is called Momonium. Goals to become a City: Land 5/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 1/3, Value produced $135/$1.5K. Clear goals - nice. Field expansion research finished (toast overlapping the tab row a bit). Next goal: hire more Momo. Tapping Got it.
Now Lv3 already (mine should open). Harvests show +$6 now - Field expansion doubled it? $53. Going to Hire to get a second Momo.
Hiring a Momo costs $100; I have $65. Another land tile offered for $55. Both farms are ripe while Momo is busy at the lab, so I'll help by harvesting by hand to save up.
$95 after harvesting. Sowing again by tapping the empty farm, then I should have $100 for a new Momo soon.
Tapped Momo by accident again (it keeps walking onto the farm I'm tapping). Interesting: Momo already looks after 3 tiles (two farms + lab) and has done 168 jobs. $107 - time to hire!
$125. Hiring a Momo for $100.
Hired 'Mochi' - so cute, happily standing by the bush. Free time. Trying the 'Assign' button this time instead of the pencil.
'Tap a building for this Momo'. Assigning Mochi to the right-hand farm, which keeps sitting ripe.
'Another Momo works here' - so each building gets one Momo, and Momo already claims all three. Mochi needs a new building. Mine should be unlocked at Lv3. Tapping the empty grass to build one.
Mine costs $120 + Wood 10, so I need wood first. Lumberyard is $80 and I have $85. Building a lumberyard here - a nice chain: wood -> mine.
Nothing happened? The Lumberyard price '$80' is shown in red even though I have $97. Confusing - red usually means can't afford. Tapping it once more.
Still nothing, still red at $115. Maybe the menu didn't refresh its prices since I opened it when I was poorer. Closing it by tapping the sky and reopening on the grass.
Reopened: Lumberyard $80 is now white. So the menu kept me locked out with stale prices while it was open - I wasted ~20 seconds. Building it now.
Lumberyard under construction (logs and a stump). I have 8 flasks and Research has a red dot. Checking what I can research while it builds.
Field expansion can go to Lv2 (4 flasks, $36), and Watering efficiency is now unlocked too. Lumberyard finished: it has Fell / Replant actions. Researching Field expansion Lv2 first.
Research running (29s). A wood counter appeared: 2 logs. Someone is already working the lumberyard (1/1). Let me read the waiting letter.
Third letter: 'Let's give the soil something back'. Opening and accepting it.
Momo writes about composting -> Bigger harvests. Accepting. Then I'll spend $55 on more land since the City goal wants 9 land tiles.

I hit the 'Lumberyard 0/1 >' label instead of the land and got a detail panel: worker slot 'Empty', Wood 2 per 16s cycle, refits into Wind turbine / Steam engine / Water wheel later. Wood 4 now. Tapping the Empty slot to put Mochi there.
A Momo is now 'Working' at the lumberyard. $111. Closing and buying the glowing sea tile ($55), tapping it above the bottom labels.
'$55 Tap again to buy'. Confirming.
New land tile with flowers and grass, the island is becoming an L-shape - it feels good to watch it grow. 8 flasks, Research dot is lit. Going to research Watering efficiency.
Field expansion reached Lv2. Watering efficiency and Bigger harvests both have yellow dots (available). Tapping Bigger harvests to see its price.
Bigger harvests: 8 flasks + $60, 2 minutes, Crops +1. I have 9 flasks and $108. Starting it - longer research but a new node.
Research running ~2 min. Both farms are full and ripe again - the Momos seem busy elsewhere. I'll harvest the right farm myself, then build a farm on the new land.

Tapped Mochi again by accident - and Mochi is STILL on 'Free time'. So the lumberyard was taken by Momo, and Mochi has been idle this whole time. Wood is 10 now. Going to build a farm on the new land for Mochi.
Harvests now pay +$9 each - the research is clearly paying off. $101. Building a Farm ($10) here.
New farm going up on the new land. Now selecting idle Mochi to send there.
Lv4! But I got Momo, not Mochi - the two bunnies look identical so I can't tell who is who. Momo covers 4 tiles. I'll open the new farm's detail and fill its Empty worker slot instead.
My tap sowed the new farm (seeds in). It shows 'Farm 0/1 >' - opening that detail to fill the worker slot.
Farm detail: crop choices (Usual / Hardy / Millet), refit into Villa / Park / Pub. Lots of depth hiding here. Tapping Empty slot to put Mochi to work.

Tapping 'Empty' did nothing this time - slot still empty. (At the lumberyard it probably only looked like it worked because Momo grabbed it on its own.) So I never managed to give Mochi a job in ~4 minutes. $155 and 14 wood though - almost enough for a Mine. Wrapping up.
Missed the bunnies and hit the lumberyard. $178, 16 wood, Lv4, Hire now has a red dot. Out of time - I'd buy a Mine next.
